verdict.rationale: Cal.com supports event-driven background automation. Webhooks fire on triggers such as BOOKING_CREATED, BOOKING_RESCHEDULED and BOOKING_CANCELLED with configurable payloads, and the Zapier app automates workflows on booking events. The Attio integration also keeps the CRM synced automatically, and llms.txt lists native "workflows". However, most of the automation logic depends on external tools (Zapier, your own webhook receivers), and native workflows get only a single passing mention. Missing for 10: documented native workflow configuration and actions, autonomous AI/agent-driven background jobs (scheduled or self-running agents rather than request-driven API/MCP calls), and independent hands-on corroboration.
